notes.whyNewYork: Nothing from the default registry is installed. The six primitives in src/components/ui are hand-written against this project's own palette (see @theme in globals.css), not copied from the registry - `ground`/`surface`/`line` replaced shadcn's `background`/`foreground`/`border` because those names describe a system rather than this one. This file exists so `npx shadcn@latest add <component>` puts new primitives in the right place with the right aliases; it is not a record of what came from upstream.
notes.whyNoRadix: Every primitive here is a plain element with variants - no overlay, no focus trap, no portal. Radix is only needed once something like a Dialog, Select or Dropdown is used, and it is not installed. Adding it for four buttons and two cards would be a dependency nobody asked for.
notes.whyNoIcons: `lucide-react` is deliberately NOT installed. The site is text; the only symbol anywhere is the CSS-drawn hero mark. Installing an icon library to render nothing is a dependency with no consumer.
